title: Golden Table Clock, 1 dollar

specs.Decoration: digital printing, plated in 24-karat gold, resin fill, zirconia insert

descriptionPlain: Description The works of the famous Fabergé studio have always been viewed as extravagant and incredibly luxurious. The list of masterpieces by Peter Carl Fabergé includes not only the world-famous, ornate Easter eggs, but also richly decorated clocks. This 24-karat gold-plated silver coin featuring the face of a table clock is sure to delight any enthusiast of the art of jewelry.
